metadata.description: Five AI specialists that bring user-centred design roles into government digital delivery teams – service design, content and interaction design, delivery, development and cyber security. For any government, anchored to a country-agnostic service standard baseline, the GOV.UK Design Principles and the GDS Way, with country profiles for local standards and design systems.

plugins.name: xstack
plugins.description: Five UCD specialists as AI team members for government digital teams. Turn a brief into testable prototypes, iterate from research, assess against your country's service standard.
